Path: graphics/graphics-path/src/main/cpp

Geode rebuilds these unchanged native sources with NDK 30 and explicit 16 KB
LOAD/RELRO alignment. The build adapter and AAR repackaging script are Geode
changes. The original AndroidX 1.1.0 classes, resources and consumer rules are
preserved. Only Geode's supported arm64-v8a and x86_64 binaries are replaced.
